_comment: web URLs are absolute: replace GATEWAY with the test gateway host before running a11y-gate.sh

exceptions.reason: The gateway header logo is Ignition's own shell chrome, not this module's markup -- this page mounts inside the standard Platform nav and cannot alter it. This module renders no of its own (icons are inline SVG).
The platform DataGrid's own page-size selector (History tab). DataGridTableProps (ignition-web-ui) exposes no label/aria-label prop for it -- verified against DataGrid.types.d.ts, 8.3.8.
The platform DataGrid's per-row expand chevron (History tab). RowExpand/DataGridTableProps expose no prop to name it -- verified against DataGrid.types.d.ts, 8.3.8.

The platform TextArea's own resize-handle button (bottom-right corner, both the Credentials drawer's Private key field and the Git Ignore raw-source editor). TextAreaProps exposes no prop to name it -- verified against TextArea.types.d.ts, 8.3.8; matched on its icon's SVG path since the wrapping class is an emotion hash.

Ignition's own gateway chrome, not this module's markup: the header's Help & Resources and admin links. Verified on 8.3.10, 03/11/2026: all 30 focus-ring-contrast stops (2) sit in the gateway header or the Platform side navigation, outside the module's .gitcfg container; the module renders no <a> and its 6 own focusable elements pass. a11y-check can only scope a focus exception by the stop's tag name, so this covers that tag everywhere on the page.

Ignition's own gateway chrome, not this module's markup: the icon rail (Home, Platform, Connections, Network, Services, Diagnostics) and the side-nav links, including this module's own Versioning menu entry. Verified on 8.3.10, 03/11/2026: all 30 focus-ring-contrast stops (26 anchors) sit in the gateway header or the Platform side navigation, outside the module's .gitcfg container; the module renders no <a> and its 6 own focusable elements pass. a11y-check can only scope a focus exception by the stop's tag name, so this covers that tag everywhere on the page.

Ignition's own gateway chrome, not this module's markup: the side-nav group headers System and Security. Verified on 8.3.10, 03/11/2026: all 30 focus-ring-contrast stops (2 divs) sit in the gateway header or the Platform side navigation, outside the module's .gitcfg container; the module renders no <a> and its 6 own focusable elements pass. a11y-check can only scope a focus exception by the stop's tag name, so this covers that tag everywhere on the page.
